programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 406
programme.desc: På en kort bådtur uden for Kristiansand finder drengene en lille perle af en hytte, med kun en spytklat over til Danmark. Ole har meget særlige planer for den udvendige del af hytten.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 407
programme.desc: Teamet skal være ekstra kreative i en hytte ved den skønne vinterdestination Sjusjøen, hvor roer og langrendsløber Birgit Skarstein og hendes sambo Martin har et trænings- og ferieparadis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 408
programme.desc: Denne gang skal to hytter dybt inde i Finnskogen renoveres. Den ene er minimalistisk og nordisk, mens den anden er traditionel og hyggelig.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 409
programme.desc: Teamet tager til Telemarks største sø, Møsvatn. De skal renovere en hytte, og Halvor bruger næsten 100 liter sort maling ude og inde, men alligevel ender hytten med en blød og behagelig atmosfære.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit rejser teamet til Harstad for at renovere en hytte til Den Norske Turistforening. Det bliver et meget særligt projekt, der tager flere uger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af sæsonen rejser vores renoveringsgenier til en hytte uden for den idylliske by Lillesand. Det bliver en uforglemmelig uge med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503
programme.desc: Teamet har aldrig før haft at gøre med en uidentificerbar flyvende genstand, men én gang skal jo være den første. Hold på hat og briller, for deres projekt i Nevlunghavn bliver en udenjordisk oplevelse.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uge påbegynder teamet en renovering, som ejerne ikke har efterspurgt. De tilbringer seks dage ved Værøy fyr uden for Lofoten på en opgave, som ejerne tror vil tage fem til seks år.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 506
programme.desc: En gammel fiskemodtagelse på Sandøya skal have en ansigtsløftning, og de vilde kræfter fra Atlanterhavet kommer til at spille en stor rolle.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 507

programme.title: Sniper 2
programme.desc: On one last mission, Thomas Beckett is sent into a remote, war-torn wasteland between Eastern Europe and Western Asia to assassinate a repressive terrorist leader. Once the mission is accomplished, Beckett and his spotter, Cole, find escaping more difficult than anticipated. In order to save their lives, Beckett and Cole must weave their way through burnt-out cities and desolate landscapes.

programme.title: Sniper 3
programme.desc: Master Gunnery Sergeant Thomas Beckett has over seventy confirmed kills in his long and illustrious career. The US Marine Corps most decorated sniper has taken out warlords, drug lords, assassins and bitter foes. This time, he's going after a friend.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: One hundred years after their ship was deliberately wrecked, the ghosts of the murdered seaman have returned to Antonio Bay to exact a ghastly vengeance.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: An engrossing suspense thriller based on actual events, THUNDERHEART stars Val Kilmer as an FBI agent with Sioux indian ancestry who is sent to a South Dakota indian reservation to capture a radical native American protester. As Kilmer struggles to get in touch with his own heritage, he begins to discover that the U.S. government has framed an innocent man.

programme.title: Snake In The Eagle's Shadow
programme.desc: SNAKE IN THE EAGLE'S SHADOW is the kung fu comedy masterpiece starring superstar Jackie Chan (RUSH HOUR, SHANGHAI NOON).

programme.title: Sinbad And The Eye Of The Tiger
programme.desc: The most ambitious of Ray Harryhausen's fabled Sinbad trilogy. When an evil sorceress turns a handsome prince into a baboon, Sinbad (Patrick Wayne) sets sail on a dangerous quest to break the witch'sspell. Co-starring Jane Seymour.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: The Man Who Would Be King
programme.desc: John Huston directed this classic Kipling adventure about British soldiers trying to bamboozle high priests in remote Kafiristan.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Lawrence Of Arabia
programme.desc: Winner of seven Academy Awards(r), including Best Picture (1962), this is the restored director's cut of the breathtaking masterpiece.

programme.title: Berry Gordy's The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Martial arts student, Leroy Green (Taimak), is on a quest to obtain the elusive all-powerful force known as "The Glow." Along the way, he must battle the evil, self-proclaimed Shogun of Harlem - a kung-fu warrior also known as Sho'nuff (Julius J. Carry III) - and rescue a beautiful singer (Prince protegee, Vanity) from an obsessed record promoter.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Dirty (2006)
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn star as the legendary lovers Robin Hood and Maid Marion, who reunite twenty years after their first meeting. Now the mother superior of a nunnery, Marion finds herselfdrawn to a somewhat less agile Robin Hood when he returns from a lengthy Crusade in the Holy Lands.

programme.title: Sheena (1984)
programme.desc: Exotic Tanya Roberts stars as Sheena, a comic book legend that comes to life. As a child, she was lost in the African jungle and adopted by the Zambouli tribe. She rules over the untamed wilds of Africa, until outsiders challenge her domain in this exotic action-adventure.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: And Justice For All
programme.desc: Al Pacino portrays a hot-shot lawyer looking for justice in a justice system run amok.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

Skip (Wilder) and Harry (Pryor) have both been fired from their jobs, so they take off in their van for California to seek fame and fortune, but somewhere along the way the van conks out and they're broke and...well, they have to eat, right? So they land a gig as singing and dancing woodpeckers to promote a bank opening. When two bank robbers steal their costumes and stick up the bank, guess who gets the blame? programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Finding Samantha struggling to repair a lamp, Aunt Clara uses her uncertain powers of magic to summon an electrician. Benjamin Franklin, in l8th century clothes, appears. Samantha is upset by Ben's presence and Aunt Clara's wail that she can't remember how to undo the spell. Darrin, astonished by Ben's appearance in his home, can't convince Larry Tate that Ben is not is creation for an advertising campaign for Franklin Elec-tronics. Abner Kravitz refuses to believe Gladys' report that the real Ben Franklin is at the Stephens'. Bowing to Samantha's pleas, Darrin agrees to allow her and Aunt Clara to show Ben how his inventions are being used is the city. The next morning Ben, leaving a note that he has decided to tour the city alone to avoid causing domestic discord, sets out. Darrin, Samantha and Aunt Clara start searching for him. At a firehouse, inspecting an old fire engine, Ben steps on the accelerator. The engine shoots out into the street and slams into a curb. Ben is arrested and taken to court, where the judge, sure it is all a publicity stunt, charges him with grand larceny and sets bail at a thousand dollars. Darrin puts up the bail, knowing he will lose it if Ben doesn't appear for trial is a month. Just then, Aunt Clara remembers the spell and Ben vanishes.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter en krig, da hun lægger an på Justin lige foran Audrina. Spencer ser på huse med Heidi og køber et hus uden hendes godkendelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Da Audrina brænder Kristin af, beslutter hun sig for ikke at kæmpe imod sin tiltrækning af Justin. Heidi melder sig til at passe naboens barn, men Spencer vil ikke have noget med børn at gøre.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får sin første forsmag på at være i et forhold med Justin, da han ikke dukker op til Brodys surprise party. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om, hvornår de skal starte en familie, og Audrina går på date med Justins bedste ven.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror, at hun har tæmmet Justin, men han har måske ikke glemt Audrina. Da Holly mister kontrollen til et event, må Heidi få sin søster til at konfrontere sit spiritusproblem.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spiller kostbar med Kristin, men hans plan giver bagslag. Hollys druk fører til en intervention af Heidi og Stephanie. Brody og Jayde skændes og genovervejer deres forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin er ude på dybt vand efter Kristin og Audrina endelig mødes ansigt til ansigt. Heidi vil have en baby til sin fødselsdag, men Spencer har noget andet i tankerne.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody overvejer at date igen, men et møde med Jayde viser, det ikke er tid. Audrina og Justin mødes for at diskutere deres fremtid, men det ender ikke, som hun havde håbet. Spencer tager drastiske tiltag mod Heidis babybesættelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin skændes med Jayde, fordi hun vil have Brody tilbage. Heidi planlægger at blive gravid med eller uden Spencers samtykke, Audrina må forholde sig til, at Justin stadig har følelser for Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke være sammen med Justin, men han lader hende ikke gå uden at kæmpe. Audrina ender alt med Justin for altid. Brody får kolde fødder, da Jayde vil flytte sammen, og Spencer frygter, at Heidi måske er gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin beslutter at tage deres forhold til det næste niveau og Spencer konfronterer Heidi om en graviditetstest. Brody har måske stadig følelser for Kristin, efter Jayde konfronterer ham om deres forhold til en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst bliver ødelagt, da hendes mor kritiserer hendes plastikoperation. Kristin og pigerne tagr til Miami til Super Bowl-weekend, men stemningen bliver dårlig, da hun fester så hårdt, at det bekymrer Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Da rygterne går om Kristins partying får Stephanie skylden. Audrina begynder at date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra at prøve at score hende. Spencer bliver vred, da han møder Stephanie til Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for sin nabo, men den bliver overskygget af at Spencer flipper ud på Holly. Kristin opfordrer Audrina til at fokusere på Ryan, og prøver derefter at få et tættere forhold til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody sætter sit venskab med Kristin på spil da han begynder at date en anden pige. Lo sender Stephanie ud på en dobbeldate. Ryan giver Audrinas venner en ny chance.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin slider med at komme videre efter Brody. Audrina møder Justin og begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Ryan. Lo bliver venner med Brodys nye kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme lægger sig ud med Kristin da hun tager en af Kristins rivalr med til en fest. Ryan kommer tilbage fra turneen, men Audrina forteæler ham ikke, at hun mødtes med Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan bliver sat på prøve, da han møder Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side da Allie skændes med hende. Stephanie har en skuffende anden date.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Lige da Audrina afslutter tingene med Ryan, overrasker Justin hende på hendes fødselsdag. McKaelas ven Allie skaber flere problemer for Kristin. Brody fortæller Justin hvad han tænker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Jackie Navarro er en af Danmarks største tv-personligheder og influencere, og i aften byder hun indenfor i sin villa nord for København. Snakken går, når Jackie åbner op om både kærlighed og had.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306
programme.desc: Det bliver en på mange måder grænseoverskridende aften, når filmproducenten Peter Aalbæk Jensen inviterer sine gæster til middag. En aften fyldt med overraskelser og uenigheder, de sent glemmer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1309
programme.desc: Flere af gæsterne føler sig hjemme, når influencer Nynne Larsen inviterer til middag i Værebroparken. På trods af den lille lejlighed, er der plads til dybe spørgsmål.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1310
programme.desc: Sanger og radiovært Nadia Malm inviterer indenfor. Spørgsmålene er mange, for hvordan er det at dele navn med én, der blev lagt for had landet over, da dokumentaren, Den Sorte Svane, kom frem.

programme.desc: Baylen tager til Florida for at finde den perfekte brudekjole sammen med sin mor og bedstemødre, og Allen får en nyhed, der kan få store konsekvenser.

programme.title: Sister Wives: Been There Done That
programme.desc: Christine, Janelle, and Meri get together for the first time in years, which brings up old wounds and leaves Meri wanting a deeper conversation.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad: Coming In Hot
programme.desc: Sarahs date tager hende til bordelkvarteret. Amber får et lidenskabeligt kys. Tony søger kærligheden i Brasilien, men har han for høje standarder?

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: The Shay Way
programme.desc: Jaimee vil have en bestemt kjole, og hendes forlovede, Lisa, vil have en buksedragt. Den kræsne bryllupsplanlægger Michelle kræver, at alt er perfekt.

programme.title: Cake Boss: College, Cherry & Challenges
programme.desc: Kage-teamet byder foråret velkomment med en kirsebærkage til en lokal park.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Transkønnede Gabrielle kommer til Kleinfeld med vennerne for at finde en smart kjole. Brooke vil have den perfekte kjole til et maraton.

programme.title: Down Home Fab: Industrial Glam
programme.desc: Chelsea og Cole arbejder for tandlæger med en dristig stil. De rykker grænserne med et moderne industrikøkken, stue og et hotelinspireret soveværelse.

programme.title: OutDaughtered: Channeling Chaos
programme.desc: Adam og Danielle beslutter om børnene er klar til deres egne kanaler på de sociale medier. De søger hjælp i hjemmet, men kan ikke finde den rette.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia
programme.desc: Deltagerne træder ind i køkkenet og finder farverige, glitrende juvelformede stykker på stande - en smagstest, hvor alle "juvelerne" er lavet af gelé.

programme.title: Halloween Cookie Challenge: Stained Glass And Funhouse
programme.desc: Fire cookiebagere fremstiller spøgelseshuse i flere etager, og holder en seance ved at lave spilbare åndebrætter med smagstilsat alkohol.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters: Another BBQ Bites The Dust
programme.desc: Tammy har svært ved at tilgive sine søskende, som vil slutte fred. Hun og Andrea er på dobbeltdate med Amy og Brian, og Amy tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Welcome to Plathville: I Came To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Efter en lang periode uden kontakt konfronterer Ethan sine forældre. Og Kim kommer med en uventet tilståelse, der efterlader Moriah målløs.

programme.title: Welcome to Plathville: What's Up, Sugar Bum?
programme.desc: Familien Plath er en blond, blåøjet familie på 11 i det sydøstlige Georgia. De deler deres lidenskab for musik, religion.

programme.title: Sister Wives: One-on-One: Part 1
programme.desc: Familien Brown samles for at diskutere deres seneste møde ved Coyote Pass. Kody og Janelle skændes om, hvem der indgik "bagdørsaftalen".

programme.title: MasterChef Australia
programme.desc: Top-10 får en hemmelig boks-udfordring, der består af en airfryer, som de skal bruge til at lave en lækker ret til dommerne - ovne er strengt forbudt.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia
programme.desc: De tilbageværende deltagere skal genskabe gæstekonditoren Philip Khourys plantebaserede dessert "Daggry over en ny tropisk dag".

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Love Is a Work in Progress
programme.desc: Caties flirten får Josh til at se rødt. Annabelle gør en opdagelse om Sheas ekskone, og Thomas og Paula kæmper for at få et liv sammen til at fungere.

programme.title: 90 Day: Hunt For Love
programme.desc: Otte singler fra 90 Day er klar til at give kærligheden en chance til i et smukt tropisk paradis på en rejse fyldt med romantik og nye chancer.

programme.title: 90 Day: Hunt For Love
programme.desc: De medvirkende giver deres ærlige mening og fortæller alt om dramaet i det forrige afsnit - og de holder sig bestemt ikke tilbage.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Last Resort: Fall On Your Last Sword
